source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Your **OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM** units can use their **Shieldbreaker**, **Soulless Horror** and **Overkill** abilities 2 times per battle rather than once, but never 2 times in one battle round.

As you [muster your army](vsdata:core-rule/muster-armies), each of your **OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM** units gets its Extremis ability below, and you must raise that unit's points cost by the amount listed for it. A unit that would take your army over the battle's points limit cannot be included. The Extremis abilities are:

- **[Decoy Targets](vsdata:ability/imperial-agents.veiled-blade-elimination-force.decoy-targets)** (**CALLIDUS ASSASSIN** only): 2 times per battle, and at most once per battle round, in [your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), another **INFANTRY** model of yours can be picked, provided it is on the battlefield, not in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy unit. That model is destroyed without triggering any rules for destroyed models, and then this model is taken off the battlefield and placed again as near as it can be to the destroyed model's spot, not in Engagement Range of any enemy unit.
- **[Esoteric Explosives](vsdata:ability/imperial-agents.veiled-blade-elimination-force.esoteric-explosives)** (**CULEXUS ASSASSIN** only): whenever you use the [Grenades](vsdata:ability/core.explosives) Stratagem on this model, each D6 of 3+, rather than 4+, inflicts a [mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds).
- **[Intraneural Biotech](vsdata:ability/imperial-agents.veiled-blade-elimination-force.intraneural-biotech)** (**EVERSOR ASSASSIN** only): you can use the [Heroic Intervention](vsdata:ability/core.heroic-intervention) Stratagem on this unit however many times that Stratagem has been used in the phase. That use then costs 1CP less, and does not stop that Stratagem from being used on other units in the same phase.
- **[Micromelta Rounds](vsdata:ability/imperial-agents.veiled-blade-elimination-force.micromelta-rounds)** (**VINDICARE ASSASSIN** only): the exitus rifle of this model gets **[[ANTI-MONSTER 4+]](vsdata:weapon-ability/anti)** and **[[ANTI-VEHICLE 4+]](vsdata:weapon-ability/anti)**.
